name: Crescendo
tagline: Augmented-AI customer experience platform blending AI agents with human support.
description: Crescendo is an augmented-AI customer experience platform that handles support across chat, voice, email, and messaging, escalating to human agents when needed. It charges on outcomes rather than seats, and pairs its AI with thousands of human CX professionals gained through its PartnerHero acquisition. Integrates with Salesforce, Zendesk, Shopify, and more.
insight: In 2024 the ~20-person startup acquired PartnerHero, adding 3,000 human CX agents — a rare early-stage acquisition of that scale.
edge: Pays-on-outcome pricing instead of per-seat, with thousands of human CX agents standing behind the AI rather than software alone.
pros: Backed by General Catalyst at $500M valuation

references.title: Crescendo Secures $50 Million for AI-Enhanced Contact Center Platform
